newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers spread narrows as 180-cst slips.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers spread narrows as 180-cst slips.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices for 180-cst grade slipped, narrowing the 180-cst and 380-cst spreads but talks were thin as most Chinese players were still on the Lunar New Year holidays, traders said on Wednesday.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $101-$103 and 380-cst at $97-99 a tonne, compared with $103-$107 and $96-$101 respectively, but buying interest remained thin, traders said.
The price differential between the two grades has narrowed to around $4 per tonne from the previous $6-$7.
"The spread is not as big as on Tuesday but with no Chinese players around, there are not many activities," said one trader.
